meta.title: Request for Best Offer in Auction: not available on plans below Growth
gaps: Verify the current tenant is on a plan below Growth or on Growth.
Repeat the same test across two tenants with different plans using the same buyer role.
Execute Request for Best Offer in an auction and verify the best-offer request with bid re-lock succeeds.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify the current tenant is on a plan below Growth or on Growth.; Repeat the same test across two tenants with different plans using the same buyer role.; Execute Request for Best Offer in an auction and verify the best-offer request with bid re-lock succeeds.

steps.note: Open an existing event; the runner should select an auction suitable for inspecting its stage actions.
Assert whether the Auction Settings menu offers the Request Best Offers capability.
